products.name: Wireless Services
products.description: Provides nationwide wireless voice and data communications, including high-speed internet over wireless devices, to consumers and businesses in the U.S. and Mexico. Delivered via AT&T's owned wireless network infrastructure, utilizing licensed spectrum and advanced technologies such as 5G.

products.name: Broadband Services (Fiber and Fixed Wireless)
products.description: Delivers high-speed internet and broadband connectivity to residential and business customers primarily through fiber-optic infrastructure and, where unavailable, via fixed wireless access (AT&T Internet Air) over the 5G network. Requires extensive physical network buildout and regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Legacy Voice and Data Services
products.description: Offers traditional copper-based voice and data services, including switched access lines and legacy telephony, primarily to business and residential customers. These services are being phased out as customers migrate to newer technologies.

products.name: Managed and Professional Services
products.description: Provides hosted and managed professional services, including network management, IP Voice, VPN, and outsourcing, to business customers. Delivered through a combination of AT&T's network infrastructure and specialized human expertise.

products.name: Wireless Equipment Sales
products.description: Sells a wide variety of wireless devices, including handsets, smartphones, data cards, and accessories, to consumers and business customers. Devices are sourced from third-party manufacturers and sold through company-owned and third-party retail channels.

products.name: Customer Premises Equipment Sales
products.description: Sells equipment such as modems, routers, and other devices required for broadband and wireline connectivity to business and residential customers. Products are sourced from third-party suppliers and delivered through AT&T's sales channels.

products.name: Aviation Connectivity Services
products.description: Provides in-flight connectivity (IFC) services, narrowband safety operational data services, and complementary digital services for commercial aircraft, business jets, and unmanned aircraft, delivered via proprietary and partner satellite networks and onboard terminals.

products.name: Government Satellite Communications (Satcom) Services
products.description: Delivers secure, high-speed broadband and narrowband satellite communications, including tactical line-of-sight and beyond-line-of-sight connectivity, ISR services, and specialized terminals for military and government users, leveraging a global satellite fleet and ground infrastructure.

products.name: Maritime Connectivity Services
products.description: Provides satellite-based broadband and narrowband communications to commercial shipping fleets, offshore service vessels, and fishing companies worldwide, including managed multi-layer connectivity and IoT integration, using a global satellite network and onboard terminals.

products.name: Fixed Broadband Internet Services
products.description: Offers high-speed, reliable fixed broadband internet access to residential and business customers, primarily via satellite, including enterprise connectivity, IoT, and prepaid internet services in underserved regions, delivered through proprietary satellites and ground equipment.

products.name: Information Security and Cyber Defense Solutions
products.description: Develops and sells advanced networking, cybersecurity, and information assurance products and services, including high-speed encryption solutions and tactical gateways, primarily for military and government customers, requiring specialized hardware and software integration.

products.name: Space and Mission Systems
products.description: Provides specialized design, development, and technology services for satellite communication system architecture, including custom satellites, modems, terminals, antennas, and gateways for government and commercial applications, involving both manufacturing and engineering services.

products.name: Tactical Networking Solutions
products.description: Offers resilient communications products and services for on-the-move or on-the-pause military operations, including friendly force tracking and narrowband solutions, often under the TrellisWare brand, requiring specialized hardware and software.

products.name: Advanced Satellite and Wireless Products and Terminals
products.description: Designs, develops, and sells advanced satellite and wireless communication products and user terminals that support fixed and mobile broadband and narrowband services, manufactured using contract and in-house production for commercial and government customers.

products.name: Advanced Technologies and Intellectual Property Licensing
products.description: Develops and licenses commercial communication satellite products, orchestrates sovereign and multi-orbit solutions, and licenses intellectual property, focusing on emerging growth markets such as direct-to-device communications.

products.name: Budoprutug (anti-CD19 monoclonal antibody therapeutics)
products.description: A clinical-stage, glycoengineered anti-CD19 monoclonal antibody designed for intravenous and subcutaneous administration to deplete CD19-positive B cells, targeting a broad range of immune-mediated diseases such as primary membranous nephropathy (pMN), immune thrombocytopenia (ITP), and systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE). Manufactured using advanced cell lines and delivered via infusion or injection, it is intended as a disease-modifying therapy.

products.name: CLYM116 (anti-APRIL monoclonal antibody therapeutics)
products.description: A next-generation, Fc-engineered anti-APRIL monoclonal antibody with a proprietary 'sweeper' mechanism, designed for subcutaneous administration to inhibit APRIL signaling and IgA production. Developed for the treatment of IgA nephropathy (IgAN) and other B-cell mediated diseases, it is manufactured using advanced antibody engineering and delivered via injection.

products.name: AI-Powered Site Search and Personalization Software
products.description: Cloud-based and on-premises software that uses artificial intelligence and machine learning to provide site search, product recommendations, and personalized experiences for eCommerce and content-driven websites. Delivered as SaaS or perpetual license, with integrations to major commerce platforms.

products.name: Digital Experience Platforms (DXP)
products.description: Comprehensive platforms for web content management, eCommerce, digital marketing, and analytics, enabling organizations to manage digital experiences and customer journeys. Includes Unbound and OrchestraCMS, delivered as SaaS or on Salesforce, with modular templates and APIs for customization.

products.name: Franchise and Multi-Unit Web Management Platform
products.description: Web content management and eCommerce platform designed for franchises and multi-unit organizations to centrally and locally manage digital properties, branding, and promotions at scale. Delivered as SaaS under the TruPresence brand.

products.name: Search Engine Optimization (SEO) Audit Software
products.description: Cloud-based software tool that provides instant technical, on-page, and off-page SEO audits with actionable insights to improve website ranking and traffic. Delivered as SaaS under the WooRank brand.

products.name: Professional Digital Services
products.description: Consulting and implementation services including digital strategy, web design and development, usability engineering, information architecture, SEO, and application development, often bundled with software products or provided as standalone engagements.

products.name: Blockchain Data Center Hosting
products.description: Provides energized infrastructure services for crypto mining customers by renting space in custom-designed data centers based on power requirements. Requires physical construction, specialized power and cooling infrastructure, and ongoing facility operations.

products.name: High-Performance Computing (HPC) Data Center Hosting
products.description: Designs, constructs, and operates data centers tailored for high power density applications such as HPC and AI, leasing space and power to customers. Involves large-scale physical infrastructure, advanced cooling, and power management systems.

products.name: Cloud Computing Services (Discontinued)
products.description: Provided cloud services to customers, including AI and machine learning developers, by renting space at third-party co-location centers and offering access to cloud computing equipment. Delivered digitally but required physical hardware and data center space.

products.name: Retail Coffee and Tea Beverages
products.description: Handcrafted coffee, tea, and other beverages sold directly to customers through company-operated and licensed Starbucks stores worldwide. These products are prepared in-store by baristas using Starbucks-roasted coffee and tea, requiring physical retail locations and in-person human labor.

products.name: Retail Food Offerings
products.description: A variety of high-quality food items, such as pastries, breakfast sandwiches, and lunch items, sold in Starbucks company-operated and licensed stores. These are sourced from national, regional, and local suppliers and require in-store preparation and service.

products.name: Packaged Coffee and Tea Products
products.description: Packaged whole bean and ground coffees, as well as tea products, sold through grocery stores, foodservice accounts, and other retail channels outside of Starbucks stores. These products are produced through Starbucks' roasting and packaging operations and distributed globally, often via partnerships such as the Global Coffee Alliance with Nestlé.

products.name: Ready-to-Drink Beverages
products.description: Starbucks-branded ready-to-drink beverages, such as Frappuccino and Starbucks Doubleshot, sold through grocery, convenience, and other retail channels globally. These are produced in collaboration with partners like PepsiCo and Nestlé and distributed outside of Starbucks stores.

products.name: Branded Merchandise and Serveware
products.description: Starbucks-branded merchandise, including serveware, cups, and other related items, sold in stores and through other retail channels. These products are sourced from various suppliers and require physical manufacturing and distribution.

products.name: (Z)-endoxifen Therapeutics
products.description: A proprietary small-molecule oral drug developed and manufactured by the company, designed as a selective estrogen receptor modulator/degrader (SERM/D) for the treatment and risk reduction of breast cancer, other breast conditions, and rare diseases such as Duchenne Muscular Dystrophy (DMD), women carriers of DMD, and McCune-Albright Syndrome (MAS). The product is produced via a proprietary manufacturing process and delivered in multiple dosage strengths, supported by qualified suppliers and manufacturing redundancies.

products.name: Galinpepimut-S (GPS) Immunotherapy
products.description: A peptide-based cancer immunotherapeutic targeting the WT1 antigen, developed as an off-the-shelf, subcutaneously administered drug for the treatment of multiple hematologic and solid tumors, including AML, MPM, MM, and ovarian cancer. Manufactured using synthetic peptide technology and delivered via injection, GPS is designed for use as monotherapy or in combination with checkpoint inhibitors.

products.name: SLS009 (Tambiciclib) CDK9 Inhibitor
products.description: A highly selective small molecule cyclin-dependent kinase 9 (CDK9) inhibitor, administered intravenously, developed for the treatment of hematologic malignancies (such as AML, lymphomas, ALL) and solid tumors. SLS009 is manufactured through chemical synthesis and delivered systemically, with clinical trials in both monotherapy and combination regimens.

products.name: Water Management and Treatment Services
products.description: Consulting, engineering, and technology services for water resources analysis, water supply management, wastewater treatment, stormwater management, flood protection, and water infrastructure. Delivered through technical consulting, engineering design, digital solutions, and operational technology, often requiring regulated infrastructure and in-person expertise.

products.name: Environmental Consulting and Remediation Services
products.description: Comprehensive environmental services including site assessment, environmental monitoring, hazardous and solid waste management, remediation of contaminated sites, and beneficial reuse of land. Delivered via field studies, engineering, regulatory compliance, and project management, often involving physical site work and regulatory oversight.

products.name: Sustainable Infrastructure and Resilient Engineering Design
products.description: Planning, architectural, and engineering design services for sustainable and resilient infrastructure, including civil, transportation, energy, and building projects. Delivered through interdisciplinary teams using advanced engineering, digital modeling, and project management, often requiring physical construction and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Disaster Management and Community Resilience Services
products.description: Disaster preparedness, response, recovery, and resilience services including monitoring, environmental response, damage assessment, program management, and mitigation planning. Delivered through rapid deployment of technical teams, digital tools, and specialized software for data management and analytics.

products.name: Advanced Analytics, Digital Technology, and AI Solutions
products.description: Provision of proprietary software, advanced analytics, AI-enabled solutions, and digital technology platforms for data collection, modeling, asset management, and optimization of infrastructure and environmental systems. Delivered as software subscriptions and consulting, requiring digital infrastructure and technical expertise.

products.name: Energy and Utility Consulting and Engineering Services
products.description: Consulting, engineering, and project management services for energy utilities, renewable energy (solar, wind, hydropower, biogas, biomass, tidal), conventional power generation, and smart grid projects. Delivered through technical advisory, engineering design, regulatory support, and operational services, often involving physical infrastructure and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Solid and Hazardous Waste Management Services
products.description: Consulting, engineering, and project management for solid and hazardous waste, including landfill design, recycling facility design, landfill gas-to-energy projects, and hazardous waste site remediation. Delivered through field engineering, regulatory compliance, and operational management.

products.name: High-Performance Building and Facility Engineering Services
products.description: Planning, architectural, and engineering services for high-performance, energy-efficient, and resilient buildings, including design for commercial, government, and specialized facilities. Delivered through interdisciplinary engineering, digital modeling, and project management, often requiring physical construction and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Aviation and Airspace Systems Consulting and Engineering
products.description: Technical consulting, engineering, and software solutions for aviation and airspace systems, including airspace optimization, systems integration, acoustic analysis, and airport facility design. Delivered through specialized engineering, data analytics, and digital solutions for government and commercial clients.

products.name: Cannabis Flower Products
products.description: Cultivated, processed, and packaged dried cannabis flower and pre-rolls for adult-use and medical markets, produced in licensed facilities in Canada and Israel and distributed globally through wholesale and pharmacy channels.

products.name: Cannabis Extracts and Concentrates
products.description: Manufactured cannabis extracts and concentrates, including oils and vaporizer products, produced in licensed facilities and distributed under various brands for both adult-use and medical markets.

products.name: Cannabis Edibles
products.description: Produced cannabis-infused edible products, such as gummies and other ingestibles, manufactured in regulated facilities and sold under multiple brands in adult-use and medical channels.

products.name: Medical Cannabis Products
products.description: A range of cannabis products, including flower, oils, and other formulations, specifically developed and distributed for medical use through pharmacies and medical distributors in Canada, Israel, Germany, the UK, and other international markets.

products.name: White-Labeled Cannabis Products
products.description: Cannabis products produced for and distributed under third-party brands, leveraging Cronos' manufacturing and regulatory expertise for select international markets.

products.name: Cannabis Seeds and Plants
products.description: Cultivation and sale of cannabis seeds and live plants, produced in licensed facilities and sold to other license holders or markets where permitted by regulation.

products.name: Contract Manufacturing and Processing Services
products.description: Provision of manufacturing and processing services for cannabis products to other license holders under contract manufacturing agreements, utilizing Cronos' licensed facilities and expertise.

products.name: Product Design and Development Services
products.description: Comprehensive design and development services for highly complex products, including new product development, product commercialization, and integration of supply chain, manufacturing, and service expertise. Delivered through global design centers using advanced technology and design automation.

products.name: Electronics and Complex Product Manufacturing Services
products.description: Manufacturing services for highly complex, regulated products, including assembly, testing, and production of electronic and electromechanical systems for sectors such as Aerospace/Defense, Healthcare/Life Sciences, and Industrial. Delivered via global, scalable operations tailored to customer needs.

products.name: Supply Chain Management Solutions
products.description: End-to-end supply chain management services, including procurement, warehousing, risk mitigation, cost optimization, and compliance with trade regulations. Services are integrated with product design and manufacturing to provide flexible and resilient solutions.

products.name: New Product Introduction Services
products.description: Services focused on accelerating time-to-market for new products, including design for excellence, lifecycle assessment, test solution design, and rapid prototyping. Delivered by dedicated teams to transition products to full volume manufacturing.

products.name: Sustaining and Aftermarket Services
products.description: Lifecycle extension and aftermarket services such as repair, refurbishment, spare parts management, depot repair, and part recovery to keep products in the market and extend their useful life. Includes proactive and circular service approaches.

products.name: Residential Mortgage Lending
products.description: Origination of one- to four-family residential mortgage loans, including both fixed-rate and adjustable-rate loans, secured by properties primarily in the local market area. Loans are underwritten to secondary market guidelines and may be sold to Freddie Mac. Requires in-person underwriting, property appraisals, and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Commercial Real Estate Lending
products.description: Origination of loans secured by commercial real estate properties, including owner-occupied and non-owner occupied properties such as medical practices, offices, warehouses, retail, and hotels. Loans are typically structured with terms and amortization periods up to 20 years, require property appraisals, and are subject to regulatory lending standards.

products.name: Multi-Family Real Estate Lending
products.description: Origination of loans secured by multi-family residential properties, such as apartment buildings, primarily within the local market area. These loans are generally adjustable-rate or have call periods, require property appraisals, and personal guarantees.

products.name: Commercial Non-Real Estate Lending
products.description: Origination of commercial loans not secured by real estate, including term loans and lines of credit for business purposes such as equipment, inventory, and receivables. Loans are secured by business assets and require financial analysis and collateral evaluation.

products.name: Construction and Land Development Lending
products.description: Origination of loans for construction of residential and commercial properties, as well as land development loans secured by lots for future development. Includes straight construction and construction/permanent loans, requiring inspections and appraisals during the construction process.

products.name: Agricultural Lending
products.description: Origination of loans for agricultural purposes, including acquisition, development, and refinancing of agricultural property, as well as financing for crop and livestock production, equipment, and capital assets. Loans include both real estate and non-real estate secured lending, requiring collateral evaluation and borrower financial analysis.

products.name: Consumer Lending
products.description: Provision of consumer loans, including dental implant loans, automobile loans, energy/home improvement loans, student loans, recreational vehicle and boat loans, and unsecured lines of credit. Loans are primarily to local customers and may be unsecured or secured by depreciating assets.

products.name: Deposit Services
products.description: Offering a variety of deposit accounts to retail and business customers, including checking accounts, savings accounts, money market accounts, certificates of deposit, and individual retirement accounts. Requires regulated infrastructure, branch network, and compliance with deposit insurance and banking regulations.

products.name: Electronic Banking Services
products.description: Provision of digital banking services such as mobile banking, online banking, bill pay, and electronic funds transfer via Zelle®. Delivered through digital platforms and requires investment in secure IT infrastructure and compliance with electronic banking regulations.

products.name: Insurance Services
products.description: Provision of insurance services through a subsidiary, including direct insurance offerings and securities sales via third-party arrangements. Requires regulatory compliance and partnership with third-party providers.

products.name: Digital Presence Management Platform
products.description: A cloud-based platform that enables businesses to manage, structure, and distribute their brand information and knowledge across digital channels, including websites, apps, search engines, and social media, leveraging the Knowledge Graph and integrations with a large Publisher Network. Delivered as a SaaS subscription, it centralizes data management and automates updates across digital touchpoints.

products.name: Listings Management
products.description: A service that allows businesses to sync and update their information (such as name, address, hours) across a network of over 200 third-party publishers, including search engines, maps, and apps, ensuring consistency and accuracy of business data online. Delivered via the cloud platform with automated integrations.

products.name: Website Landing Pages (Pages)
products.description: A product that enables businesses to create, manage, and update landing pages on their own websites at scale, using structured data from the Knowledge Graph to ensure up-to-date and accurate information is presented to consumers. Delivered as a SaaS tool integrated with the platform.

products.name: Review Management (Reviews)
products.description: A solution for businesses to collect, monitor, and respond to consumer reviews from multiple sources, including their own website and third-party platforms, with tools to increase review quantity and quality and manage reputation. Delivered through the platform with analytics and response capabilities.

products.name: On-Site Search (Search)
products.description: A natural-language search engine for business websites and digital properties, allowing consumers to search a company's Knowledge Graph and receive direct answers, maps, and relevant results. Delivered as a SaaS feature integrated into customer websites and apps.

products.name: Social Media Engagement (Social)
products.description: A tool that enables businesses to post, engage, and respond to content, comments, and offers across multiple social media channels, helping brands manage and grow relationships with local customers at scale. Delivered as a SaaS solution integrated with the platform.

products.name: Professional Communication and Compliance (Relate)
products.description: A product designed for regulated industries (e.g., financial services) that enables compliant client engagement via text messaging and mobile voice calling, integrating with CRM and archival systems, and providing AI-powered insights for better communication. Delivered as a SaaS module integrated with the platform.

products.name: Analytics and Insights (Scout)
products.description: An analytics suite that provides businesses with performance data and actionable recommendations regarding their digital presence, including search rankings, consumer interactions, and benchmarking against competitors. Delivered as a SaaS analytics dashboard within the platform.

products.name: Data Integration and Connectors
products.description: A set of tools and frameworks (Connectors, App Directory) that allow businesses to integrate and unify data from various external sources into the Knowledge Graph, enabling consolidated content management and powering experiences across channels. Delivered as part of the platform with pre-built and custom integrations.

products.name: Professional Services
products.description: Custom implementation, integration, and ongoing maintenance services provided by project managers, engineers, and design experts to tailor the platform to customer needs, including building custom landing pages and data integrations. Delivered as fee-based consulting and support services.

products.name: Apartment Community Leasing
products.description: Leasing of apartment homes in company-owned or managed multifamily residential communities, primarily located along the West Coast. This involves physical real estate assets, on-site property management, and regulated housing operations.

products.name: Development and Redevelopment of Apartment Communities
products.description: Development of new apartment communities and redevelopment of existing properties to enhance value and rental income. This requires real estate development expertise, construction management, and regulatory approvals.

products.name: Preferred Equity Investments in Multifamily Real Estate
products.description: Provision of preferred equity capital to multifamily stabilized communities or development projects, earning a preferred rate of return. This is a financial investment product involving capital deployment and risk management.

products.name: Property Management Services for Joint Ventures and Co-Investments
products.description: Management of apartment communities owned through joint ventures or partnerships, including earning management, development, and asset management fees. This involves operational oversight and service delivery to externally owned properties.

products.name: Commercial Real Estate Leasing
products.description: Leasing of space in operating commercial buildings owned by the company. This involves physical property management and tenant services for non-residential real estate.

products.name: Healthcare Staffing Services
products.description: Provision of temporary and permanent placement of nurses, allied health professionals, and healthcare leaders in clinical and non-clinical roles, delivered through a national network using both in-person and digital recruitment and assignment management.

products.name: Physician and Advanced Practice Staffing (Locum Tenens)
products.description: Recruitment and placement of physicians, nurse practitioners, physician assistants, and CRNAs on temporary assignments at healthcare facilities nationwide, managed through a combination of national recruiting and digital assignment tools.

products.name: Education Staffing Services
products.description: Placement of teachers, substitute teachers, special education providers, behavioral aides, and related healthcare professionals in educational facilities, using specialized recruitment and workforce management tailored to schools and educational organizations.

products.name: Home-Based and Senior Care Staffing (PACE and Community Care)
products.description: Provision of clinical and non-clinical staffing for home health, senior care, and PACE programs, including recruitment, consulting, and management solutions to support aging populations in home and community settings.

products.name: Workforce Management Technology (Intellify®)
products.description: Cloud-based SaaS platform providing vendor management, workforce analytics, and real-time insights for healthcare and education organizations to manage internal and contingent labor, integrating with core systems and supporting centralized staffing operations.

products.name: Managed Service Programs (MSP) and Vendor Neutral Programs
products.description: Comprehensive outsourced management of all or part of a customer’s contingent staffing needs, including both internal placements and coordination of third-party staffing agencies, delivered via proprietary technology and consultative services.

products.name: Recruitment Process Outsourcing (RPO) and Talent Acquisition Services
products.description: Outsourced recruitment solutions for permanent hiring, including executive search, contingent search, and recruitment process outsourcing, delivered through specialized teams and digital platforms to healthcare and education organizations.

products.name: Project Management Staffing Solutions
products.description: Rapid deployment of comprehensive staffing plans and project management for urgent or large-scale needs, such as system upgrades or labor disruptions, providing organized placement of healthcare professionals within short timeframes.

products.name: Executive and Interim Leadership Search
products.description: Placement of interim and permanent executives and leaders in clinical, administrative, and operational roles for healthcare and education organizations, using retained and contingent search models with performance-based fees.

products.name: Antibody-Based Oncology Therapeutics
products.description: Innovative antibody-based drugs for cancer treatment, including monoclonal antibodies, bispecific DART and TRIDENT molecules, and antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs). These are developed using proprietary engineering platforms and manufactured in cGMP facilities, with some products marketed by partners and others in clinical or preclinical development.

products.name: Contract Development and Manufacturing Services (CDMO)
products.description: Outsourced contract development and manufacturing of antibody-based therapeutics and bulk drug substances for third-party biopharmaceutical companies, using a commercial-scale cGMP facility. Services include process development, clinical and commercial manufacturing, and supply of drug substance.

products.name: Type 1 Diabetes Therapeutic (TZIELD)
products.description: A monoclonal antibody (teplizumab-mzwv) for delaying the onset of Stage 3 type 1 diabetes, developed and out-licensed to partners for global commercialization. MacroGenics retains certain economic rights and milestone payments.

products.name: Oncology Therapeutics (Small Molecule Drug Candidates)
products.description: Development and commercialization of precision oncology small molecule drugs, including LP-300, LP-184 (STAR-001 for CNS indications), LP-284, and LP-100, for the treatment of various solid tumors and hematological cancers. These drugs are discovered, rescued, or developed using proprietary AI and biomarker-driven approaches, and are delivered through clinical trials and, if approved, commercial pharmaceutical channels.

products.name: Antibody-Drug Conjugate (ADC) Oncology Therapeutics
products.description: Development of highly specific antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs) with potent drug payloads for cancer treatment, leveraging AI-powered modules for target identification and optimization. These are manufactured through collaborations and advanced through preclinical and clinical development for potential commercialization.

products.name: Artificial Intelligence Oncology Drug Discovery Platforms (RADR® and withZeta.ai)
products.description: Provision of AI-driven platforms (RADR® and withZeta.ai) for oncology drug discovery, biomarker identification, patient stratification, and translational research support. These platforms are offered to external biopharma companies, researchers, and drug developers via subscriptions, access, and services, and are built on proprietary big data analytics and machine learning infrastructure.

products.name: PredictBBB Web Application
products.description: A web-based application that predicts the ability of small molecules to cross the blood-brain barrier, using AI models trained on molecular characteristics. This tool is offered to external users in the drug development community for research and development purposes.

products.name: Bitopertin (Heme Biosynthesis Modulation Therapies)
products.description: Oral small molecule GlyT1 inhibitor developed to modulate heme biosynthesis, primarily for the treatment of erythropoietic porphyrias (EPP, XLP), and being explored for other hematologic diseases such as Diamond-Blackfan Anemia. Manufactured via chemical synthesis and delivered as oral tablets.

products.name: Hepcidin Suppression Therapies (DISC-0974, DISC-0998)
products.description: Injectable monoclonal antibody therapies targeting HJV to suppress hepcidin production and increase serum iron, developed for anemia of myelofibrosis, anemia of inflammatory bowel disease, and other anemias of chronic disease. Manufactured using biologic processes and delivered via subcutaneous or intravenous injection.

products.name: Hepcidin Induction Therapies (DISC-3405 and related anti-TMPRSS6 antibodies)
products.description: Monoclonal antibody therapies designed to induce hepcidin production and reduce serum iron, targeting diseases of excessive red blood cell production such as polycythemia vera and sickle cell disease. Manufactured using biologic processes and delivered via subcutaneous or intravenous injection.

products.name: Ferrous Metal Products
products.description: Processed and recycled ferrous metals, including heavy melting steel, plate and structural, and shredded scrap, produced through crushing, shredding, and advanced separation at company-operated facilities. Sold to steel producers and other buyers for use in steel production.

products.name: Nonferrous Metal Products
products.description: Processed and recycled nonferrous metals such as aluminum, copper, stainless steel, nickel, brass, titanium, lead, alloys, and mixed metal products, separated and sorted by type, grade, and quality for sale to external customers.

products.name: Catalytic Converter Sales
products.description: Recovered catalytic converters from end-of-life vehicles are sold to processors who extract precious metals such as platinum, palladium, and rhodium. This involves manual removal and separate processing prior to vehicle shredding.

products.name: Metal Recycling Services
products.description: Collection, classification, and processing of scrap metal from suppliers including corporations, manufacturers, retail customers, and government organizations, involving transportation, sorting, and preparation of metals for recycling and resale.

products.name: End-of-Life Vehicle Purchasing Platform (ScrapApp.com)
products.description: Digital platform facilitating the direct purchase of end-of-life vehicles from individuals, including quoting, scheduling pickups, and automating transactions, with vehicles processed through company recycling operations.

products.name: Selonabant (CB1 Antagonist) for Cannabis-Induced Toxicity
products.description: A small molecule CB1 receptor antagonist developed in both oral and intravenous formulations to rapidly reverse the symptoms of cannabis-induced toxicity, including acute cannabinoid intoxication in adults and unintentional cannabis poisoning in pediatric patients. Requires pharmaceutical manufacturing, clinical development, and regulatory approval; delivered as a prescription drug for emergency and acute care settings.

products.name: MOLBREEVI (molgramostim inhalation solution)
products.description: An inhaled biologic drug-device combination consisting of recombinant human GM-CSF (molgramostim) delivered via a proprietary eFlow® Nebulizer System, developed and manufactured through outsourced partners, for the long-term treatment of autoimmune pulmonary alveolar proteinosis (autoimmune PAP).

products.name: aPAP ClearPath Testing Program
products.description: A no-charge, third-party diagnostic testing service in the U.S. providing sensitive and specific quantitative immunoassays (serum-based or dried blood spot) for GM-CSF autoantibodies to aid in the diagnosis of autoimmune PAP, developed in partnership with a CLIA-certified lab and delivered to healthcare providers.

products.name: Savara Expanded Access Program (EAP) for MOLBREEVI
products.description: A program enabling physicians to request access to MOLBREEVI for eligible autoimmune PAP patients in select geographies where the product is not commercially available, in compliance with local regulatory requirements, prior to full commercial launch.

products.name: Overriding Royalty Interests in Oil and Natural Gas
products.description: The Trust collects and distributes income from overriding royalty interests in oil, natural gas, and other minerals produced from offshore leases in the Gulf of America. These royalties are based on a percentage of the value at the well of oil, natural gas, or other minerals produced and sold by third-party operators. The Trust does not operate wells or engage in production, but solely administers and liquidates these royalty rights for distribution to unitholders.

products.name: Cross-Platform Audience and Advertising Measurement
products.description: Provides measurement of audiences and advertising across linear TV, connected TV, digital platforms, and movie theaters, using proprietary data science and large-scale data integration. Delivered via SaaS platforms, APIs, and data feeds, enabling buyers and sellers to transact on advertising and optimize campaigns.

products.name: Digital and Social Media Audience Measurement
products.description: Measures website and application audiences, engagement, and demographics across computers, smartphones, tablets, and social media platforms, providing syndicated data for media planning, competitive intelligence, and content valuation. Delivered through subscription-based platforms.

products.name: Video and TV Audience Measurement
products.description: Delivers measurement of TV viewing (national and local), on-demand video, and digital video consumption across devices, providing unduplicated reach, engagement metrics, and audience demographics for broadcasters, advertisers, and content owners.

products.name: Theatrical Box Office Measurement and Analytics
products.description: Provides detailed measurement and analytics of domestic and international theatrical box office receipts, attendance, and audience demographics, including electronic reporting and exit polling services for movie studios and theater operators.

products.name: Programmatic Advertising Activation and Targeting Solutions
products.description: Offers activation and targeting solutions for digital, mobile, and CTV campaigns, including audience and content activation, pre-bid inventory filters, and ID-free predictive audience segments, integrated with programmatic advertising platforms.

products.name: Custom Research, Data Feeds, and Insight Solutions
products.description: Delivers custom research, data integrations, survey analytics, and bespoke insight deliverables tailored to client needs, including brand health, market segmentation, and competitive benchmarking, across TV, digital, and cross-platform environments.

products.name: Home and Connected Device Measurement Solutions
products.description: Measures consumer engagement and content consumption across connected home devices, including CTV, IoT devices, and network-connected devices, providing insights into streaming activity and technology usage within households.

products.name: Theatrical Distribution and Cinema Management Software
products.description: Provides software solutions for theatrical distribution, exhibitor management, and cinema operations, including booking, accounting, and theater management systems for movie studios and theater operators.

products.name: DatChat Messenger & Private Social Network

products.name: Natural Gas Marketing Services
products.description: Marketing and sale of natural gas commodity and related energy products to residential, commercial, and industrial customers, including price stability and utility bill management offerings in competitive markets.

products.name: Outdoor Lighting and Utility Services
products.description: Provision of outdoor lighting and other customer-focused utility services to electric utility customers, leveraging existing electric infrastructure and in-person service delivery.

products.name: Digital Wireless Communications and Fiber Optic Services
products.description: Provision of digital wireless communications and fiber optic services to external customers, primarily in the Southeast, using a dedicated wireless network and fiber infrastructure.

products.name: Distributed Energy and Microgrid Solutions

products.name: Titanium Dioxide Pigments (TiO2)

products.name: Iron-Based Chemicals

products.name: Other Specialty Chemicals
products.description: Side-stream products from TiO2 production, these specialty chemicals are used in applications such as pearlescent pigments, electroceramic capacitors for electronics, and natural gas pipe manufacturing.
